verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document pricing per tool call or per connection, and it does not document rate limits. The docs cover connection handling, OAuth, token scoping, publishing and the CLI, but none of them mention pricing or rate limits. The hosted connection services were also shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
